rolesAndResponsibilities: Lead Frontend Development: Own the design and implementation of intuitive, responsive UIs for our AI knowledge platform using React and TypeScript, impacting thousands of users daily from day one. Feature Ownership: Work closely with product and design teams to translate user needs into features – from concept, through architectural design, to polished release. You’ll build everything from rich web app interfaces to Chrome extension features, with an eye for detail and robustness. Code Quality & Performance: Write clean, maintainable code and unit tests, and conduct peer code reviews to ensure a high-quality codebase. Optimize for performance and scalability so our frontend remains fast and stable as usage grows. Cross-Stack Collaboration: Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs seamlessly and influence overall architecture. You’ll frequently dive into the full stack to ensure end-to-end excellence in delivering features. Innovation & Improvement: Continuously improve our frontend tooling and developer experience. We experiment with new technologies – even leveraging AI coding agents like Cursor to complete complex tasks in hours– so you’ll be encouraged to automate, innovate, and bring in best practices that push our velocity and quality forward. Mentorship: As a senior member, guide and mentor junior developers by sharing knowledge and leading by example. Foster an environment where “no endless meetings, no debugging marathons – just shipping great code” is the norm.

rolesAndResponsibilities: You own a product surface end to end: you talk to the customer, form the idea, build it, ship it, measure it, and decide what happens next. You'll build at the center of a multi-trillion-dollar industry that still runs on phone calls, spreadsheets, and tribal knowledge. You'll work at an inflection point in how software itself gets built. AI-assisted development has collapsed the distance between an idea and a working version of it. Build, not just specify. Prototype new product iterations yourself using AI-assisted and LLM-assisted tooling, fast, disposable, real. Stay close to customers. Spend time where the work happens. Understand what estimators, parts managers, and others actually do, where they lose time, and what better would feel like. Own the outcome. Steer by your surface's metrics; adoption and value delivered are yours. Make the trade-off. Weigh product impact against engineering effort in the same breath, and find the cheaper path to the same outcome.

rolesAndResponsibilities: Définir et piloter l'architecture technique de la refonte des interfaces homme-machine (IHM) des Postes de Commandes Centralisées, en migrant des applications client lourd C++ vers une solution client léger React. Recueillir et analyser les besoins auprès des équipes de développement et des équipes métier, en les traduisant en exigences techniques claires et actionnables. Concevoir et développer une architecture front-end robuste et maintenable, en assurant la cohérence avec les systèmes existants en C++. Définir les standards, les bonnes pratiques et les guidelines de développement React à l'échelle du département. Assurer la cohérence technique entre les composants existants en C++ et les nouvelles interfaces React, notamment en matière d'APIs, d'échanges de données et d'interopérabilité. Participer activement aux revues de code et de conception, garantissant ainsi la qualité et la performance des livrables. Contribuer à l'élaboration de la feuille de route technique et à la planification des différentes phases de migration.

jobTitle: Staff Software Engineer, Web Frontend — Platform Services
rolesAndResponsibilities: Lead the design and evolution of our React-based platform architecture, serving as the technical anchor for one of the most demanding and highest-leverage projects in the company. Own frontend performance end to end: rendering strategy, bundle optimization, data-fetching patterns, and the observability to prove improvements with real-user metrics (Core Web Vitals, INP, TTI). Build and integrate AI-enabled features and infrastructure, including streaming LLM responses, real-time inference-driven UI, agentic workflows, and the state/data patterns that make AI experiences feel fast and reliable. Define and champion state management strategy across the platform, choosing the right tool for the job across Redux, Zustand, and RxJS-based reactive patterns, and guiding teams on when and how to use each. Evolve our build and developer-experience tooling on Vite, keeping local iteration fast and production builds lean as the codebase scales. Partner closely with Product and Design to translate UX intent into technical architecture, advocating for the user in technical decisions and for technical reality in product decisions. Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raise the bar through design reviews, and influence engineering direction beyond your immediate team. Make pragmatic build-vs-buy and prioritization decisions informed by business context, considering cost, time-to-market, customer impact, and long-term maintainability.

rolesAndResponsibilities: The R&D Engineer will be responsible for driving the design, development, and enhancement of the ARIS Flows UI — an advanced visual flow builder that makes AI-powered workflow automation accessible to business users. You will work closely with UX designers, product management, and backend engineers. This role demands a passion for crafting intuitive, high-performance interfaces and the ability to express complex AI-driven capabilities in elegant, user-centered designs — using AI tools to accelerate every phase of development. Essential Functions: Technical implementation of innovative UI components for the ARIS Flows visual builder, including canvas interactions, trigger configuration, and flow step authoring. Build and evolve AI-assisted authoring experiences: surfaces where LLM-generated suggestions, flow previews, and contextual recommendations meet the user. Apply AI-assisted development practices throughout the full software lifecycle: using tools like Claude Code for component generation, automated testing, accessibility review, and localization. Support the entire product lifecycle, from requirements analysis to testing and cloud deployment. Work in an Agile software development process in international, cross-site teams. Schwartz, Ph.D. Bio and Appearances Administrative Team Our Team: Trainers International Partners Community Access Programs DE&I Careers Corporate Social Responsibility Contacts Trainings Level 1 North American Trainings International Trainings Learning Objectives Level 2 North American Trainings International Trainings Learning Objectives Level 3 North American Trainings International Trainings Learning Objectives IFS Foundations for Coaches Program Assistants Applications PA Development Email Notifications Scholarships IFS Certification IFS Certification Policy IFS Certification Reviewers IFS Recertification IFS Approved Clinical Consultants IFS Digital Badges Terms of Use for IFS™ Credentials Online Learning IFS Continuity Program Online Circle The Self-Led Coach On-Demand Learning Conference Resources Help Center Articles Videos Podcasts and Teleconferences Community IFS Foundation Research and Bibliography IFS Trainer Career Path News & Events News Events Find a Professional Contact IFS store IFS Online CircleLearn the foundations of the IFS model & become IFS InformedEnroll Now Healing Interventions for Protective SystemsIFS with Trauma, Substances, Food, and moreLearn More IFS in Challenging TimesLearn from leading voices in IFS during this two-day online event.Register Today 2026 IFS Annual ConferenceTaking place virtually October 15-16, 2026Learn more Celebrating Difference: IFS, Ableism, and the Unburdening of NormalAn IFS Continuity ProgramLearn More Discovering Internal Family SystemsA Free 3-Hour Introductory WebinarWatch the Replay On-Demand LearningDeepen your IFS skills at your own pace with advanced on-demand programs.Learn More A Six-week Online CourseSelf paced learning for your personal growthRegister with Sounds True What is Internal Family Systems?Internal Family Systems℠ (IFS℠) is a therapeutic model that views every human being as a system of protective and wounded inner parts guided by a core Self. It teaches that the mind is naturally multiple—and that this multiplicity is healthy—because, like members of a family, inner parts can be pushed into extreme roles but also have valuable inherent qualities. IFS helps people access their undamaged, compassionate Self, which knows how to heal, and from that inner leadership, understand and transform their parts, fostering both inner and outer connectedness. The IFS Institute’s mission is to bring more Self leadership to the world. IFS is a non-pathologizing psychotherapy used in clinical settings and was developed by the founder of the IFS Institute, Dr. Richard Schwartz. For decades, the IFS Institute has been the sole provider of training and certification in Internal Family Systems. Our professional training and certification pathway sets a distinguished standard for mental health professionals. In addition to being a non-pathologizing psychotherapy, IFS also provides a way of better understanding personal and intimate relationships and stepping into life with the 8 Cs: confidence, calm, compassion, courage, creativity, clarity, curiosity, and connectedness. Professionals from many different backgrounds such as body workers, mediators, school administrators, life coaches, and religious leaders have used IFS as a lens to inform and guide their work. We continue to expand our programming to provide education to individuals and professionals other than mental health professionals. If you’d like to stay informed about future offerings, you’re warmly invited to join our email list. Regarding the research base for IFS. Early randomized trials and quasi-experimental studies suggest that IFS may benefit patients with depression and/or PTSD, including consistent improvements in self-compassion. However, the evidence base remains small, and more condition specific research is needed. For a more detailed description of the current state of the evidence base and our commitment to developing this base, please see this note. https://ifs-institute.com/resources/research We look forward to having you join our growing community of professionals and individuals using IFS to bring more Self leadership to the world. VideoWhat is Internal Family Systems TrainingProfessional IFS Training and CertificationIFS Institute offers three progressive levels of professional training for those wishing to become IFS therapists and practitioners. An IFS Level 1 Training is your gateway to truly understanding and embodying the IFS model, both in your own life and in your work with others.IFS Certified Therapists and IFS Certified Practitioners carry a distinguished mark demonstrating competency and experience of the IFS model. Learn more about becoming IFS Certified here.In 2024 we introduced a General Application and Registration Process for IFS Level 1, 2, and 3 Training programs. Learn more about this process here >
